citations.assessment: The exact Yerushalmi gives Simon of Teri ruling on a pot put on the ground, followed by Elazar recounting bringing water from one floor to another. Both speak in Hoshaya’s name.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
